name: Aadun (Nigerian Corn Flour with Palm Oil)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Combine the corn flour, palm oil, chili pepper, and salt in a bowl.
Leave the mixture to sit for 2–3 hours.
Shape the mixture as desired, and serve with drinks.

culture.text: Aadun is a street snack popular among the Yoruba speaking states in Nigeria. The name aadun means sweetness and it is also commonly served at weddings and naming ceremonies.
